name: Text Case Converter
description: Convert text into UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case, or PascalCase.
seoText: The Text Case Converter allows quick transformation of any text into various capitalization styles. Ideal for programmers, writers, and editors who need consistent casing across titles, variables, and database keys.

faq.a: Uppercase, lowercase, Title Case, sentence case, camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case, and PascalCase.

faq.q: Is data stored on the server?
faq.a: No, all conversions occur client-side in your web browser.

name: Word & Character Counter
description: Real-time count of words, characters, sentences, paragraphs, and estimated reading time.
seoText: Monitor text length, word density, and character limits in real time. Perfect for meeting essay length requirements, social media character caps, and article reading time estimations.

faq.a: Estimated using an average reading speed of 200 words per minute.

name: Lorem Ipsum Dummy Text Generator
description: Generate clean placeholder text by paragraphs, sentences, or words for mockups and UI design.
seoText: Generate standard Cicero Lorem Ipsum dummy text for mockups, web layouts, and graphic design without relying on slow external generators.

faq.q: Can I choose the number of paragraphs?
faq.a: Yes, specify any number between 1 and 20 paragraphs.

name: URL Slug Generator
description: Transform titles, article headlines, and filenames into clean, SEO-optimized URL slugs.
seoText: Convert titles and phrases into URL-friendly slugs by stripping special characters, normalizing accents, and replacing spaces with clean hyphens.

faq.a: Yes, all special symbols and punctuation marks are stripped automatically.

name: Remove Duplicate Lines
description: Clean up lists by eliminating duplicate rows, empty lines, and optionally sorting alphabetically.
seoText: Clean up large datasets, email lists, keywords, and code entries by removing duplicate lines instantly with optional sorting.

faq.a: Yes, you can deduplicate while keeping order or sort A-Z.

name: Line Sorter & Numberer
description: Sort lists in alphabetical (A-Z), reverse (Z-A), or length order, and prefix line numbers.
seoText: Organize text lines alphabetically, numerically, by length, or in reverse order. Add line numbers or prefixes with one click.

faq.a: Yes, standard natural sorting is supported.

name: Find & Replace Text
description: Search and replace text strings or regular expressions across multiple paragraphs instantly.
seoText: Quickly replace recurring words, variables, or patterns in large text blocks. Supports both plain matching and RegExp patterns.

faq.a: Yes, toggle the RegExp checkbox to use regex patterns.

name: Text & String Reverser
description: Reverse characters, reverse word order, or flip lines upside down.
seoText: Reverse any text string by character or by word. Great for testing palindrome strings, obfuscation, or creative typography.

faq.q: Can I reverse words instead of letters?
faq.a: Yes, toggle between character reversal and word order reversal.

name: Morse Code Translator
description: Encode messages into International Morse Code and decode dots and dashes back into text.
seoText: Translate plain text into International Morse Code audio patterns and decipher incoming dots and dashes back into readable text.

faq.a: Standard dot (.) and dash (-) characters with slashes (/) for word boundaries.

name: JSON Formatter & Validator
description: Format, beautify, minify, and validate JSON data with clear syntax error detection.
seoText: Format, validate, and clean JSON payloads with customizable indentation. Instantly pinpoint missing commas, invalid brackets, and syntax errors.

faq.q: Can it minify JSON for production?
faq.a: Yes, click the Minify button to compress JSON to a single line.

name: JSON to YAML Converter
description: Convert JSON configuration files to YAML format and YAML back to JSON in real time.
seoText: Seamlessly translate Kubernetes, Docker Compose, and CI/CD configurations between JSON and human-readable YAML syntax.

faq.q: Does it support arrays and nested objects?
faq.a: Yes, full hierarchical structure is preserved in conversion.

name: Base64 Text Encoder & Decoder
description: Encode plain text to Base64 format or decode Base64 strings back to UTF-8 text.
seoText: Encode authentication headers, data tokens, and raw strings into Base64 format, or decode encoded strings back into clean UTF-8 text.

faq.a: Yes, UTF-8 unicode encoding is fully supported.

name: URL Encoder & Decoder
description: Encode text into URL percent-encoded format or decode encoded URLs back to plain text.
seoText: Escape special query parameter characters according to RFC 3986 URI standards, or decode percent-encoded URLs back into readable text.

faq.a: Special characters like spaces and ampersands must be encoded to avoid breaking URL structure.

name: HTML Entity Encoder & Decoder
description: Escape HTML markup characters into safe entities or decode entities back into raw HTML.
seoText: Convert HTML characters like <, >, &, and quotes into safe entities to display code snippets without rendering them as active tags.

faq.a: Yes, both named entities (&) and numerical entities (&) are supported.

name: CSS Minifier & Beautifier
description: Compress CSS stylesheets by removing whitespace, or format unreadable minified CSS cleanly.
seoText: Optimize stylesheet sizes for faster web load times by stripping whitespace, or beautify minified CSS with clean indentation.

faq.a: No, rules and selectors remain identical; only superfluous formatting is removed.

name: SQL Query Formatter & Beautifier
description: Format unorganized SQL queries into clean, readable code with uppercase keywords.
seoText: Beautify complex SQL SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, and JOIN statements with standard capitalization and readable indentation.

faq.a: Standard ANSI SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, and SQL Server syntax.

name: Crontab Expression Generator
description: Generate, test, and explain Unix cron schedule expressions in plain English.
seoText: Build cron schedule strings visually. Select minutes, hours, days, and months, and get clear human-readable explanations of when your job runs.

faq.a: Standard 5-field Unix cron: Minute Hour Day Month Weekday.

name: Docker Run to Docker Compose Converter
description: Convert complex docker run commands into clean docker-compose.yml configuration files.
seoText: Easily transform docker run CLI commands with ports, volumes, environment variables, and restart policies into valid docker-compose.yml files.

faq.q: Does it parse volume mounts and ports?
faq.a: Yes, -p, -v, -e, --name, and --restart flags are parsed automatically.

name: User-Agent Parser & Device Inspector
description: Inspect your browser User-Agent string, operating system, screen resolution, and client metadata.
seoText: Analyze User-Agent strings to identify browser version, engine family, operating system architecture, and client viewport dimensions.

faq.q: Does it detect my current browser?
faq.a: Yes, active browser details are prefilled automatically on page load.

name: HTTP Status Codes Quick Reference
description: Searchable dictionary of HTTP status codes (2xx, 3xx, 4xx, 5xx) with RFC definitions.
seoText: Quick reference for all official HTTP response codes. Understand the difference between 401 Unauthorized, 403 Forbidden, and 502 Bad Gateway.

faq.a: Yes, common Cloudflare and Nginx custom codes (like 520, 521, 522) are noted.

name: UUID v4 Generator (Bulk)
description: Generate cryptographically secure version 4 Universally Unique Identifiers (UUIDs) in bulk.
seoText: Generate RFC 4122 compliant 128-bit UUID v4 strings for database keys, session IDs, and tracking tokens with cryptographic randomness.

faq.a: The probability of a duplicate UUID v4 is virtually zero (1 in 2^122).

name: Strong Password Generator
description: Create customizable, cryptographically strong random passwords with custom lengths and symbols.
seoText: Protect your online credentials with high-entropy passwords generated using browser crypto hardware algorithms.

faq.q: Are the generated passwords stored anywhere?
faq.a: No, passwords are generated completely in memory and never transmitted.

name: Cryptographic Hash Generator
description: Compute SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, and SHA-512 checksum hashes from any text input.
seoText: Calculate real-time cryptographic hash digests using official Web Crypto API implementations. Verify data integrity and password hashes.

faq.a: SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, and SHA-512.

name: JWT Token Decoder & Inspector
description: Decode JSON Web Token (JWT) headers and payload claims without revealing your secret key.
seoText: Safely decode and inspect JSON Web Tokens (JWT). View expiration dates, claims, issuer details, and algorithm headers without server validation.

faq.q: Is the secret key required to inspect claims?
faq.a: No, JWT payload and headers are Base64URL-encoded and can be read by anyone.

name: Color Converter & HEX/RGB/HSL Picker
description: Convert colors between HEX, RGB, HSL, and CMYK with a visual color picker and preview.
seoText: Convert color formats for CSS stylesheets and graphic design. Preview color swatches and copy HEX, RGB, or HSL values instantly.

faq.a: Yes, use the interactive color picker box to select any shade.

name: Unix Timestamp Converter
description: Convert Unix epoch timestamps to human-readable dates and formats, or dates to epoch timestamps.
seoText: Convert 10-digit epoch seconds and 13-digit epoch milliseconds to localized ISO 8601 date strings and vice versa.

faq.q: Does it support local timezone and UTC?
faq.a: Yes, both UTC and local timezone representations are displayed.

name: Binary Code to Text Converter
description: Convert 8-bit binary code into readable text and encode plain text into binary strings.
seoText: Translate ASCII characters to 8-bit binary sequences and decode binary strings back to readable text.

faq.a: Standard 8-bit space-separated binary notation.

name: Number Base Converter (Hex, Dec, Oct, Bin)
description: Convert numbers between Decimal, Hexadecimal, Binary, and Octal formats with instant calculation.
seoText: Perform conversions across standard computer numerical bases: Decimal (Base 10), Hexadecimal (Base 16), Binary (Base 2), and Octal (Base 8).

faq.a: Yes, standard BigInt precision is supported.

name: PX to REM CSS Converter
description: Convert CSS pixels (px) to REM units based on customizable root font size (default 16px).
seoText: Streamline responsive web design by converting pixel values to relative REM units based on your project's base font size.

faq.q: What is the standard base font size?
faq.a: Standard browser default is 16px (1rem = 16px).

name: Byte Size Storage Converter
description: Convert data storage sizes across Bytes, KB, MB, GB, TB, and PB in both decimal and binary formats.
seoText: Calculate storage values across Bytes, Kilobytes, Megabytes, Gigabytes, and Terabytes in 1000 (SI) and 1024 (IEC) formats.

faq.q: What is the difference between MB and MiB?
faq.a: 1 MB is 1,000,000 bytes (decimal), while 1 MiB is 1,048,576 bytes (binary).

name: QR Code Generator & Downloader
description: Create high-resolution QR codes for URLs, contact cards, Wi-Fi keys, and plain text with PNG download.
seoText: Generate clean, scannable QR codes instantly from URLs, phone numbers, or arbitrary text. Download the generated code as a high-resolution PNG image.

faq.q: Can I download the QR code?
faq.a: Yes, you can save the QR code image directly to your device.

name: SVG Placeholder Image Generator
description: Generate custom SVG placeholder images with custom dimensions, colors, and labels.
seoText: Quickly create placeholder mockup images for web development and wireframes with customizable width, height, colors, and labels.

faq.q: Can I copy the SVG code directly?
faq.a: Yes, you can copy the raw SVG markup or download the SVG file.

name: Aspect Ratio Calculator
description: Calculate image and video dimensions preserving 16:9, 4:3, 1:1, or custom aspect ratios.
seoText: Find proportional width and height for images, video players, and banners. Supports standard 16:9, 4:3, 21:9, and custom ratios.

faq.a: Enter width or height, and the corresponding dimension is calculated automatically.
